description: Sector detection rules and industry-specific insights for DataSoul AI Brain

sectors.name: Retail & E-Commerce
common_threats: Duplicate order IDs inflating revenue
Zero-movement SKUs tying up working capital
Inconsistent product categories fragmenting analytics
Missing inventory levels causing stockout blind spots
Price outliers from data entry errors
insight_templates: Revenue {direction} {pct}% in {period} led by {top_category} sales, but {zero_movement_pct}% of SKUs had zero movement, tying up {working_capital} in dead stock.
Top {top_n} products account for {revenue_pct}% of revenue — classic Pareto distribution. Consider focusing inventory investment on these {top_n} items.
Average order value varies {aov_variance}% across {dimension} — standardizing pricing strategy could capture an additional {opportunity} in revenue.
{discount_pct}% of orders had discounts applied, averaging {avg_discount}%. Excessive discounting may be eroding margins by {margin_erosion}.
Inventory turnover is {turnover} days, {comparison} to the retail industry average of 30-45 days. {recommendation}

sectors.name: Healthcare
common_threats: Duplicate patient records (catastrophic for treatment safety)
Missing diagnosis codes affecting billing accuracy
Inconsistent medication names risking drug interaction analysis
PII exposure (patient names, SSNs in analytics data)
Stale discharge data affecting bed management
insight_templates: Average length of stay is {avg_los} days, {comparison} the healthcare benchmark of {benchmark} days for {department}.
Readmission rate of {readmit_pct}% detected — {count} patients readmitted within 30 days. This exceeds the CMS benchmark of 15.6%.
{missing_diagnosis_pct}% of records have missing diagnosis codes, potentially affecting ${billing_impact} in reimbursements.
⚠️ {duplicate_patients} duplicate patient records detected — this is a patient safety risk. Duplicate records can lead to wrong treatments, missed allergies, and medication errors.
Bed occupancy is at {occupancy_pct}% — {occupancy_assessment}. Target range is 75-85% for optimal patient care and resource utilization.
compliance_notes: HIPAA compliance requires all patient PII to be de-identified before analysis
Minimum Necessary Standard: only include data elements necessary for the analysis purpose
Audit trail required for all data access and transformations on patient data

sectors.name: Finance & Banking
common_threats: Duplicate transactions inflating revenue/costs
Missing payment dates affecting aging reports
Broken invoice chains disrupting audit trails
Negative balance anomalies indicating data errors or fraud
Credit score outliers from data quality issues
insight_templates: Outstanding receivables total {amount} with {overdue_pct}% past due. Aging analysis shows {aging_30} in 30-day, {aging_60} in 60-day, {aging_90} in 90-day buckets.
Default rate of {default_pct}% detected across {count} accounts — {comparison} to the industry average of {benchmark}%.
{duplicate_txn_count} duplicate transactions detected totaling {duplicate_amount} — these may inflate revenue by {inflation_pct}%.
Cash flow pattern shows {pattern} — {count} gaps in monthly data suggest incomplete transaction capture affecting financial forecasting.
Invoice completeness is {completeness_pct}% — {missing_count} invoices missing key fields (amount, date, or vendor), potentially affecting tax compliance.
compliance_notes: SOX compliance requires complete audit trail of all financial data transformations
PCI-DSS: credit card numbers must NEVER appear in analytics datasets
All financial data transformations must be reversible and documented

sectors.name: Human Resources
common_threats: Duplicate employee records inflating headcount and payroll
Missing performance ratings skewing talent reviews
Salary outliers from data entry or inconsistent currency
PII exposure (SSN, personal addresses in analytics data)
Inconsistent department names fragmenting org analysis
insight_templates: Attrition rate is {attrition_pct}% ({count} departures in {period}) — {comparison} the HR industry average of 10-15%.
Salary distribution is {skewness_desc} with median {median_salary} vs mean {mean_salary} — executive compensation pulls the mean up by {pull_pct}%.
Average tenure is {tenure} years. {short_tenure_pct}% of employees have been with the company less than 1 year — potential onboarding retention issue.
Performance rating distribution: {pct_high}% high, {pct_mid}% meets expectations, {pct_low}% needs improvement — {distribution_assessment}.
{dept_count} department name variations detected (e.g., 'Engineering', 'engineering', 'Eng') — standardizing would improve org chart accuracy.
compliance_notes: Salary data is highly sensitive — ensure access controls are in place
Performance data requires consent for analysis in many jurisdictions
Employee data processing must comply with local labor laws

sectors.name: Manufacturing & IoT
common_threats: Sensor noise spikes creating false quality alerts
Missing production records during shift changes
Machine ID inconsistencies between systems
Duplicate batch records affecting quality traceability
Stale maintenance records risking equipment failure
insight_templates: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) is {oee_pct}% — {comparison} the world-class benchmark of 85%. Availability: {availability}%, Performance: {performance}%, Quality: {quality}%.
Defect rate is {defect_pct}% with {top_defect} being the most common defect type ({defect_share}% of all defects).
Machine {machine_id} shows {anomaly_count} sensor anomalies in the last {period} — potential early warning of equipment failure.
Production downtime totals {downtime_hours} hours in {period}, with {top_cause} accounting for {cause_pct}% of all downtime.
Yield rate of {yield_pct}% means {waste_pct}% of raw materials are wasted — optimizing {top_waste_process} could save {savings}.

sectors.name: Education
insight_templates: Average GPA is {avg_gpa} with {low_gpa_pct}% of students below 2.0 — targeted intervention could improve retention.
Attendance rate of {attendance_pct}% — students with <75% attendance have {correlation} lower GPAs on average.
Drop-out rate is {dropout_pct}% with {top_semester} being the highest risk period ({semester_pct}% of all dropouts).
Course completion rate is {completion_pct}% — {bottom_courses} courses have completion rates below 60%, suggesting curriculum or teaching challenges.

sectors.name: Logistics & Supply Chain
insight_templates: On-time delivery rate is {otd_pct}% — {comparison} the industry benchmark of 95%. {late_count} shipments were {avg_delay} days late on average.
Average transit time is {transit_days} days with {variance_pct}% variance — {top_route} has the most inconsistent delivery times.
Freight cost per unit is {cost_per_unit} with {carrier} being the most cost-effective carrier ({savings_vs_avg} vs average).
Supplier {supplier} has a lead time of {lead_time} days — {comparison} the average of {avg_lead_time} days. Consider diversifying supply sources.

sector_detection_algorithm.method: Column name matching with weighted scoring
steps: 1. Lowercase all column names and remove underscores/spaces
2. For each sector, count how many detection_columns match (fuzzy match > 80%)
4. Select sector with highest match_score above threshold (0.15)
5. If no sector exceeds threshold, classify as 'General Business'
6. If multiple sectors tie, use the one with higher detection_confidence
